title: Agentic AI & Generative AI Masterclass
content: Comprehensive 12-week program covering Autonomous Agents, LLM Fine-tuning, RAG architecture, LangChain, and LangGraph. Prerequisites: Python proficiency. Fee: $250 with flexible installments. Includes capstone industry defense and verified certification.

title: Full Stack Web Engineering (Django & React)
content: 16-week live bootcamp covering PostgreSQL, Django REST Framework, modern React/Tailwind frontend, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Projects included: E-commerce and AI CMS. Schedule: Weekend live labs and weekday assignments.

title: Big Brains Virtual Internship Program
content: 6 to 8-week structured virtual internship for top-performing students. Interns collaborate on client deliverables, participate in code reviews, and receive recommendation letters alongside a performance stipend.

title: Corporate AI & Enterprise Transformation
content: Big Brains provides tailored enterprise training, agentic workflow automation, and custom model deployment for enterprises and educational institutions.

title: Refund and Certification Policy
content: Students can request a 100% refund within the first 7 days of course commencement. Verified digital certificates require at least 80% lab attendance and a passing capstone evaluation score.

title: Free Learning Community & Code Repositories
content: Access free starter kits, GitHub boilerplate code, weekend webinars, and our 24/7 Discord support community for peer troubleshooting.
